CA.rationale: No explicit attention/processing condition linked to identified content; A absent.

COD.rationale: Content (red at p0/current/n0) is identified and presented (coordinate set) and an origin/status is provided, all tied to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation linking processing condition to the same content's presentation or access.

C.rationale: Multiple literal content-identification lines specify colours at coordinates (identified content and attribute).

D.rationale: The report separately provides content identity (colour/coordinate) and a separate origin/status field for the same referent, distinguishing content from provenance/status.

O.rationale: The text specifies how the grid is organized and provides explicit presentation coordinates for content (bound to referent/time).
